conversation_groups.flow: Selected good and category determine one pitch; follow-up retains the good and proposed market town.

conversation_groups.flow: Original town-share/region selector chooses country account or rival rumor. Each is one complete answer to the inquiry, not a long consecutive speech by one person.

conversation_groups.name: Trend forecasts and town relief replies
conversation_groups.flow: Specific trend state or supplied relief selects the applicable forecast or grateful result; do not concatenate independent alternatives.

conversation_groups.name: Passage request and answer
conversation_groups.flow: Trend-spreader asks for passage to another town square; accept leads gratitude and mission, refuse leads courteous apology.
